(pha)༄༅/ /gshed dmar lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ /༄༅/ /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// gshed dmar lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ dpal gshin rje gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du dpal gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ dmar po bsgoms pa las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs pas/ rang gshin rje gshed du gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du ma he dmar po'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni/ gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar dang*/ g.yon brkyang bas tshang ra'i steng na brdzis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang mi mgo dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dbyug to 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen la 'bar zhing*/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo// phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dī pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai bi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas de rnams kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur zhing*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ dbang gi lha de rnams ye shes pa'i tshul gyis rang la bstim pas rang gi snying gar nyi ma'i steng du/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba dang*/ de'i yang thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po nas 'bru tsam zhig bsams nas/ sems dpa' gsum po de la dmigs la yid mnyam par gzhag go /de nas sngags bzla bar 'dod na snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' ma la/ sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla'o// gtor ma legs par bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas/ rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ de rnams la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/

oṃ rat+ka ya ma a ri/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis dbul/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod nas gshegs su gsol/ kha zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi lus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa'i bsam pas bza' bar bya'o// nyal pa'i tshe/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal zhing*/ ldang ba'i tshe/ lha'i nga rgyal gyis langs nas/ spyod lam thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyis ci bder spyad do// gshin rje gshed dmar sgrub pa'i thabs// sngags 'chang 'phags pas sbyar nas ni// rgyal bu maṅga la la phul// dge des sangs rgyas thob par shog /gshin rje gshed dmar lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs sa pho 'brug gi lo khyi'i zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin par cong tor sbyar ba'o/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
